== English errata comparison sources ==
The 29 January 2002 Supplement replaces the completion line and leaves the Limited mentor and apprentice clauses intact. The January 2013 PC slip and the 2023 Appendix A also use the shorter mentor and apprentice clauses. The 2013 slip adds a leading bullet to the label. Both complete errata images and the 2023 entry use the dotless title. The physical Revised face uses the shorter clauses but still says “everywhere are ignored.” The documentary Decipher article keeps its own publication identifier. The verified bare GEMP blueprint implements the PC text.
